# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated: CN code missing

The ruleset requires three inputs. The SEE is selected jointly by **CN code and country**, so the scenario is incomplete:

| Required input | Provided? |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code of the good | ❌ Only "a steel product." No CN code is given. |
| (b) Country of production | ✅ China |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 500 t |

"Steel product" could match several CN codes in the table, and each has a different default SEE for China. The ruleset says not to estimate when an input is missing, so I have not chosen a code or used an average.

## What's needed

Please give the **CN code** of the good. For reference, the China values in the table are:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE, China (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen (iron, not steel) | 1.66 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots of iron and non-alloy steel | 1.74 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 3.314 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations | 3.169 |

For 500 t, the result would be **SEE × 500 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimals. Once you confirm the CN code, I'll give the final figure.
